{'已退休的大律師吳靄儀，在 8.18 流水式集會案涉參與未經批准集結罪成，判監 9 個月、緩刑兩年，被大律師公會投訴專業失當，大律師紀律審裁組今年 6 月以大比數裁定投訴不成立。大律師公會執委會上周五（7 日）提司法覆核，要求法庭推翻判決、宣告投訴成立，並下令審裁組向吳發信訓誡、或發還由其他人組成的審裁組重新考慮。 大律師公會指，審裁組指吳靄儀的行為不應受道德譴責亦並非可恥，是與原審裁決抵觸、對刑事法庭的附帶攻擊，又強調吳的行為向公眾發放錯誤訊息，在政治動盪時期，大律師也可接受公然漠視法律的行為，為港人樹立壞榜樣。《集誌社》就事件向吳靄儀查詢，她以短訊回覆指 「不予置評」（no comments） 。': 'Retired barrister Margaret Ng, who was convicted of participating in an unauthorised assembly in the August 18 water-style assembly case, was sentenced to nine months\' imprisonment, suspended for two years. The Bar Association lodged a complaint against her for professional misconduct, but the Bar Disciplinary Tribunal ruled by a large majority in June this year that the complaint was not established. The Bar Association\'s Executive Committee filed a judicial review last Friday (7th), requesting the court to set aside the ruling, declare the complaint established, and order the tribunal to issue a reprimand letter to Ng, or remand the case to a differently constituted tribunal for reconsideration. The Bar Association stated that the tribunal\'s finding that Ng\'s conduct did not merit moral condemnation and was not shameful was inconsistent with the original judgment and amounted to a collateral attack on the criminal court. It also stressed that Ng\'s conduct sent a wrong message to the public—that during politically turbulent times, barristers could also accept openly disregarding the law—setting a bad example for Hong Kong people. The Collective (集誌社) contacted Ng about the matter; she replied via text message saying "no comments".'}

{'2021 年，吳靄儀被裁在 8.18 流水式集會案，參與未經批准集結罪成。（資料相片）': 'In 2021, Margaret Ng was found guilty of knowingly participating in an unauthorised assembly in the August 18 water-style assembly case. (File photo)'}

{'專業失當投訴不成立': 'Professional misconduct complaint not established'}

{'申請人為大律師公會執行委員會，擬答辯人為由資深大律師郭莎樂、大律師趙芷筠及施麗珊組成的大律師紀律審裁組，利害關係方為吳靄儀。': 'The applicant is the Executive Committee of the Hong Kong Bar Association. The proposed respondent is the Bar Discretionary Tribunal consisting of Senior Counsel Eva Sit (郭莎樂), barrister Lily Ching (趙芷筠) and Olivia Sze (施麗珊). The interested party is Margaret Ng.'}

{'根據入稟狀，吳靄儀自 1988 年成為大律師，執業至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，在 8.18 流水式集會案被裁明知而參與未經批准集結罪成，判監 9 個月、緩刑兩年。大律師公會指吳的行為可能損害大律師聲譽，或削弱公眾對大律師專業的信心，違反《行為守則》，但大律師紀律審裁組今年 6 月 8 日，以大比數裁定該投訴不成立。': "According to the originating summons, Ng was admitted as a barrister in 1988 and practised until 31 December 2025. She was convicted of knowingly participating in an unauthorised assembly in the August 18 water-style assembly case and sentenced to nine months' imprisonment, suspended for two years. The Bar Association considered that her conduct might have damaged the reputation of the bar, or undermined public confidence in the profession, in breach of the Code of Conduct. However, the Bar Discretionary Tribunal ruled by a large majority on 8 June this year that the complaint was not established."}

{'申請方：審裁組裁決與原審抵觸': 'Applicant: Tribunal ruling inconsistent with original judgment'}

{'入稟狀指，審裁組裁定投訴不成立，是根本上出錯，大律師公會為履行監管職責及促進公眾信心提出司法覆核。申請方引原審法官指，眾被告蓄意藐視法律、以「疏散人群」的虛假藉口繞過禁令，有預謀挑戰警方權威、法律及秩序，在動盪時期刻意違法及挑戰公共秩序，認為涉案罪行嚴重及不可接受，尤其當行為是由被公眾期望尊重和維護法治的大律師所干犯。': 'The originating summons stated that the tribunal\'s decision to dismiss the complaint was fundamentally wrong. The Bar Association brought the judicial review to fulfil its regulatory duties and promote public confidence. The applicant cited the trial judge, who said the defendants had deliberately flouted the law, used the false pretext of "dispersing the crowd" to circumvent the prohibition, and had premeditatedly challenged police authority, the law and order, and deliberately broken the law and challenged public order during turbulent times. The offence was considered serious and unacceptable, especially when committed by barristers whom the public expected to respect and uphold the rule of law.'}

{'申請方續指，審裁組錯誤自我引導及誤解法律原則，未有集中考慮吳有否違反大律師公會的《行為守則》，而是抽象考慮有否「專業失當」；而審裁組裁定吳的犯罪行為不應受道德譴責亦並非可恥，是與原審裁決相抵觸、對刑事法庭裁決不被允許的「附帶攻擊」（collateral attack）。': 'The applicant further stated that the tribunal had misdirected itself and misunderstood legal principles, failing to focus on whether Ng had breached the Bar Association\'s Code of Conduct, instead considering abstractly whether there was "professional misconduct". The tribunal\'s ruling that Ng\'s criminal conduct did not merit moral condemnation and was not shameful was inconsistent with the original judgment and amounted to an impermissible "collateral attack" on the criminal court\'s decision.'}

{'申請方又認為，審裁組錯誤考慮吳靄儀的政治動機，指法庭一向嚴謹應用法律、亦必須將政治排除在司法程序之外，審裁組考慮其政治動機並以此合理化其行為，已超越法律分析恰當允許的範圍。而即使按審裁組邏輯，吳靄儀相信她在做正確的事，但根據案例，對法律知情而刻意的挑戰、即使背後有值得讚揚的理由，仍會損害律師專業聲譽及構成專業失當，何況吳靄儀是選擇不依循合法途徑、按自己意願行使公義（take the law into her own hands）以推動其政治動機，令香港社會嚴重分裂。': "The applicant also considered that the tribunal had wrongly taken Ng's political motives into account, stating that the courts had always applied the law strictly and must keep politics out of judicial proceedings. The tribunal's consideration of her political motives and use of them to justify her conduct exceeded the proper bounds of legal analysis. Even under the tribunal's logic, Ng believed she was doing the right thing, but according to case law, a knowing and deliberate challenge to the law—even for a worthy cause—still damages the reputation of the legal profession and constitutes professional misconduct. Moreover, Ng chose not to follow lawful channels, but instead took the law into her own hands to advance her political motives, causing serious division in Hong Kong society."}

{'8.18 流水式集會案中，梁國雄、黎智英、李卓人、吳靄儀、何俊仁、李柱銘及何秀蘭七人在原審，被裁定「組織未經批准集結」及「明知而參與未經批准集結」兩罪成，判囚 8 至 18 個月，其中李柱銘、吳靄儀、何俊仁獲判緩刑；「組織未經批准集結罪」定罪其後上訴得直。': 'In the August 18 water-style assembly case, Leung Kwok-hung, Jimmy Lai, Lee Cheuk-yan, Margaret Ng, Albert Ho, Martin Lee and Cyd Ho were convicted at trial of both "organising an unauthorised assembly" and "knowingly participating in an unauthorised assembly", and sentenced to between 8 and 18 months\' imprisonment. Martin Lee, Margaret Ng and Albert Ho received suspended sentences. Their convictions for "organising an unauthorised assembly" were later overturned on appeal.'}

{'申請方：吳靄儀公然違法樹立壞榜樣': "Applicant: Ng's open defiance of the law sets a bad example"}

{'對於審裁組指，吳靄儀的罪行與其大律師身分欠足夠關聯。申請方同認為錯誤，引原審提到案中有 3 名被告受過法律訓練、是非常有經驗的律師，無疑對《公安條例》熟悉。申請方指當中必然包括吳靄儀，而當 3 名律師被公眾目睹持橫額帶領非法遊行，向公眾發放的訊息，就是即使經驗豐富的律師，亦不認為蓄意及明知違法有任何問題，此舉會損害香港法治，監管大律師的機構亦絕不能容忍。': "As for the tribunal's finding that there was insufficient connection between Ng's offence and her status as a barrister, the applicant also considered this to be in error. The original trial noted that three of the defendants were legally trained and highly experienced lawyers who were undoubtedly familiar with the Public Order Ordinance. The applicant stated that Ng must have been among them. When three lawyers were seen by the public holding banners and leading an unlawful march, the message sent to the public was that even experienced lawyers saw no problem with deliberately and knowingly breaking the law. This damaged Hong Kong's rule of law, and the body that regulated barristers could not possibly tolerate it."}

{'申請方又指，審裁組似乎暗示，因吳靄儀將大部分時間投入立法會，因此其行為與其大律師專業無關。但申請方指，投訴重點並非吳靄儀將多少時間投入大律師執業，而正正因為吳是知名政治人物、公眾皆知道她具有大律師資格，因此她錯誤而不可接受、凌駕法律的行為，會向公眾發放完全錯誤的訊息，尤其在動盪及政治情緒高漲的時期，就是只要主觀上不認同法律內容，並相信在做正確的事，即使是經驗豐富的大律師及曾經的法律界議員，也可接受公然漠視法律的行為，認為這無疑為港人、尤其是支持吳政見的人樹立壞榜樣。': 'The applicant further pointed out that the tribunal seemed to imply that because Ng had devoted most of her time to the Legislative Council, her conduct was unrelated to her profession as a barrister. However, the applicant stated that the complaint was not about how much time Ng had spent in practice. Precisely because Ng was a well-known political figure and the public knew she was a barrister, her wrongful and unacceptable conduct in placing herself above the law sent a completely wrong message to the public—especially during turbulent times of high political emotions—that as long as one subjectively disagreed with the law and believed one was doing the right thing, even an experienced barrister and former legal-sector legislator could accept openly disregarding the law. This undoubtedly set a bad example for Hong Kong people, particularly those who shared her political views.'}

{'吳靄儀、何俊仁、李柱銘等七人就參與未經批准集會罪成上訴至終審法院，爭議檢控、定罪損害集會自由，在 2024 年被駁回。（資料相片）': 'Margaret Ng, Albert Ho, Martin Lee and the other defendants appealed their convictions for participating in an unauthorised assembly to the Court of Final Appeal, arguing that the prosecution and convictions infringed freedom of assembly. The appeal was dismissed in 2024. (File photo)'}

{'要求法庭推翻判決、下令訓誡': 'Application seeks to set aside ruling and order reprimand'}

{'大律師公會最後指，理解吳靄儀自 2025 年底已退休，但強調糾正根本的法律錯誤對公眾利益仍然重要，以維護公眾對大律師專業的信心。公會要求法庭推翻審裁組判決，宣告針對吳靄儀的投訴成立，並下令審裁組向吳靄儀發信訓誡，或下令將投訴交由不同人士組成的審裁組重新考慮。而即使司法覆核勝訴，申請方亦不會申請訟費。': "The Bar Association finally stated that it understood Ng had retired at the end of 2025, but emphasised that correcting a fundamental legal error remained important to the public interest so as to maintain public confidence in the bar. The Association asked the court to set aside the tribunal's ruling, declare the complaint against Ng established, and order the tribunal to issue a reprimand letter to Ng, or order the complaint to be reconsidered by a differently constituted tribunal. Even if the judicial review succeeded, the applicant would not apply for costs."}

{'翻查資料，所有大律師均受《行為守則》規管，而若大律師公會執委會因收到申訴或其他原因，而認為應對某大律師的行為操守進行研訊，便須呈交「大律師紀律審裁團」的審裁組召集人。審裁團為獨立運作，成員皆由終審法院首席法官委任，大律師公會執委會的成員沒資格獲委任或留任為審裁團成員。在投訴轉介後，審裁組召集人會從審裁團委任一名資深大律師、一名大律師及一名非法律專業人士進行研訊。若裁為專業失當，審裁組有權頒佈紀律處分，包括譴責、罰款、暫時吊銷或正式取消執業資格。': "According to information, all barristers are subject to the Code of Conduct. If the Executive Committee of the Bar Association, upon receiving a complaint or for other reasons, considers that a barrister's conduct should be investigated, it must refer the matter to the convenor of a Discretionary Tribunal of the Bar Disciplinary Tribunal Panel. The Panel operates independently; its members are all appointed by the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal. Members of the Bar Association's Executive Committee are not eligible to be appointed or to remain as Panel members. After a complaint is referred, the convenor will appoint one Senior Counsel, one barrister and one non-legal person from the Panel to conduct the inquiry. If professional misconduct is found, the tribunal has the power to impose disciplinary sanctions, including censure, fines, temporary suspension or formal striking off."}
